title.rendered: Daily Word: Poju- Oyemade -“Lips that move”

excerpt.rendered: It takes these two faculties of yours functioning properly in order to receive the benefits of Christ in your life, a mouth that speaks and eyes that see.…

content.rendered:
It takes these two faculties of yours functioning properly in order to receive the benefits of Christ in your life, a mouth that speaks and eyes that see.

Many when believing God for a thing have understood the importance of “lips that move” but few have realized that your eyes must continuously make contact with the evidence God provides in His word for it. Failure to constantly behold with your inner eyes the evidence in the word will put a stop to the power that it is already in operation through the spoken word.
